role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 暗影萨满可以为友军迅速开出一条直捣敌军基地的行进之路。运用闪电魔法打击敌人，操控妖术干扰敌军，强大的毒蛇守卫将轻松摧毁敌人的防御工事。
hero_summary_en: Shadow Shaman quickly clears the way for his team's forces to march on the enemy base. Blasting enemies with shocking spells and interrupting attackers with hexes, his powerful serpent wards destroy enemy defenses with ease.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
abilities.description_zh: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
notes_zh: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。
notes_en: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
abilities.description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
abilities.description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
notes_zh: 目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。
notes_en: The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

scepter_loc.en: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
abilities.description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。
notes_en: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.

shard_loc.en: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.
shard_loc.zh: 伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_urnaconda
abilities.description_zh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的生命值和攻击力为平常群蛇守卫的%megaward_multiplier_tooltip%倍，持续%ward_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has %megaward_multiplier_tooltip%x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts %ward_duration%s.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
abilities.description_zh: 召唤%ward_count%个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
abilities.description_en: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.

shard_loc.en: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
shard_loc.zh: 可以使用巨蟒之瓮技能制造一个巨蛇守卫。

facet_text_en: Summons a single massive Serpent Ward with %mega_ward_multiplier_damage%x damage and %mega_ward_multiplier_health%x health and bounty values.
facet_text_zh: 召唤一个巨大的毒蛇守卫，攻击力为%mega_ward_multiplier_damage%倍，生命值和击杀金钱为%mega_ward_multiplier_health%倍。
